# Accepted capabilities

### capability-accept-and-assign-delivery
## Accept and assign delivery

Create a delivery from a command, choose a fitting locker in the requested zone, set the pickup deadline, persist assignment state, notify readiness, and return a receipt.

Claims:
- [claim-accept-flow](claims/p-3aa976f766d8-001.md#claim-claim-accept-flow)
- [claim-assignment-policy](claims/p-3aa976f766d8-001.md#claim-claim-assignment-policy)

Evidence:
- file: src/com/blueprint/fixture/lockers/application/DeliveryApplicationService.java:1-105
- file: src/com/blueprint/fixture/lockers/domain/ZoneAwareLockerPolicy.java:1-17

### capability-cancel-delivery
## Cancel delivery

Cancel a queued or assigned delivery, release an assigned locker, mark its parcel returned, and save the delivery and locker state.

Claims:
- [claim-cancellation-flow](claims/p-3aa976f766d8-001.md#claim-claim-cancellation-flow)

Evidence:
- file: src/com/blueprint/fixture/lockers/application/DeliveryApplicationService.java:1-105
- file: src/com/blueprint/fixture/lockers/domain/Parcel.java:1-70

### capability-import-csv-manifest
## Import CSV manifest

Read a five-column CSV manifest with optional header and blank-row handling, convert locker sizes and trimmed fields, and delegate each line to delivery acceptance.

Claims:
- [claim-manifest-input](claims/p-3aa976f766d8-002.md#claim-claim-manifest-input)
- [claim-manifest-delegation](claims/p-3aa976f766d8-002.md#claim-claim-manifest-delegation)

- file: src/com/blueprint/fixture/lockers/application/ManifestImportService.java:1-26
